youtube.baslik: How fast does the brainstem respond to sound? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The auditory brainstem response (ABR) appears within roughly the first 10 milliseconds after the stimulus. Its amplitude is usually below one microvolt, so 1000 to 2000 sweeps are averaged.
